questions.text: Define a stack and state its two primary operations.
questions.model_answer: A stack is a linear data structure that follows Last In First Out (LIFO) order. Its primary operations are push (insert an element on top) and pop (remove the top element).

rubric.description: Defines a stack as a linear data structure following LIFO order
